deviations.what: The Worker sends the visitor's IP in its own header, overwriting any client-sent value; the lens trusts it only when the Worker's credential verifies, otherwise behaving as today, with a test that a forged header without the credential is ignored
deviations.reason: The t2 spike measured a Cloudflare Worker address as the client through a same-zone Worker, so assumption c34 is false and all visitors would share one rate-limit bucket

deviations.what: t9 must prove a browser-style POST through the Worker reaches spark2's tunnel with Origin accepted; if cf.resolveOverride can't do it, t6's configured public origin is the fallback
deviations.reason: The t2 spike only tried resolveOverride against the same host, so reaching a second tunnel is unproven
